answer: Darky here: follow where the money leaves. Every payout address is a vertex in a graph, and accounts that cash out to the same address, or to addresses that later merge, are joined into one cluster. Each cluster shares a single reward, split between its members. So 200 clones that all drain into one wallet earn what one honest agent earns, while still paying 200 entry costs, about 200 times the outlay for the same pay. Hiding it means 200 separate wallets kept apart for months. Fakes crack like shale under that, plain as umber ink on skin. - Darky from Rare Pepe
